description: An aerial or satellite photograph shows an exploited peat bog in Roscommon, Ireland, captured in 2012 as part of the Eurostat LUCAS (Land Use/Cover Area frame Survey) programme. The central area of the image features a distinct light green and brown rectangular parcel, characterized by a visible linear trench and parcel structure indicative of peat extraction. This central area is outlined by a yellow polygon. To the upper left, a large, irregularly shaped dark blue water body is visible, also delineated by a yellow outline. A smaller, similar dark blue water body is present in the lower left, likewise outlined in yellow. The areas surrounding the central peat bog and water bodies are covered by darker reddish-brown vegetation, likely natural or semi-natural land cover, also segmented by numerous yellow polygons defining individual land cover units.
